tasks.instruction: Fix sum_even(numbers) to return the sum of only the even integers, including negative even integers. An empty list returns 0. Do not mutate the input.
Fix clamp(value, lower, upper) to return lower below the interval, upper above it, or value inside it. Inputs are integers with lower <= upper; boundaries are inclusive.

Fix is_palindrome(text) for ASCII strings. Ignore case and all non-alphanumeric characters, then test whether the remaining characters read the same forwards and backwards. Empty or punctuation-only strings return True.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!

tasks.instruction: Fix unique_order(numbers) to return each integer once, preserving the order of first appearance. Return a new list and do not mutate the input.

Fix count_words(text) to return a dictionary mapping each case-sensitive whitespace-separated token to its occurrence count. Preserve punctuation in tokens. Empty or whitespace-only strings return an empty dictionary.
